title: Ship-To Count Limit and One Ship-To per Delivery Location
content:
**Ship-To Fulfillment Account — portfolio limits (Customer Care desk standard).**

1. A customer may hold up to 25 ship-to accounts, one per delivery location.
2. A ship-to is not opened for a site that already has a ship-to of the customer whose status is pending setup, active or suspended; a suspended ship-to is reactivated instead.
3. Requests beyond the cap are referred to the customer's account manager and are not opened by the desk.

### How the site is matched

The site is the same site when the customer, the site name and the delivery ZIP code of the request match those of an existing ship-to of that customer, and the status that counts is the status shown on the system record of that existing ship-to, read before the request is acted on.

| Existing ship-to of the customer at the same site name and ZIP | Effect of clause 2 on a new request for that site |
|---|---|
| status pending setup | not opened |
| status active | not opened |
| status suspended | not opened; the suspended ship-to is reactivated instead |
| status closed | clause 2 does not bar the request |
| none | clause 2 does not bar the request |

### Basis Q&A

**Does the 25-account cap count ship-tos across all of the customer's sites?** Yes. The cap is on the ship-to accounts a customer holds, one per delivery location; a request beyond it is referred to the customer's account manager and is not opened by the desk.

**Does a different ZIP code at a site of the same name count as the same site?** No. The site match is on the customer, the site name and the delivery ZIP together.
